description: Electric vehicle charging bays is a dataset listed in Australian national open data portal, an open data portal, published or maintained by City of Sydney. We’re working with Ausgrid on a trial of on-street electric vehicle charging. Charging bays are installed and managed by Ausgrid and it's charging partners EVX and Plus ES. This trial will help us better understand on-street electric vehicle charging needs and demand at suitable locations in our area. Coverage: City of Sydney. The portal files it under the publisher City of Sydney. Its tags are City of Sydney, EV, car, charging, electric. The portal shows 2026-06-21 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support traffic, parking and road network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ckan-au-portal.
